name: Crystal of Arcane Assimilation
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot —; Price 3,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This beautiful gem changes color to compliment any weapon it is attached to and moves about the item until it finds a esthetically pleasing position and then fuses with the item. If a special ritual is preformed, (requiring 8 hours) the weapon the crystal has attached to can absorb half the total gold piece value of any magical weapon that is part of the ritual. If it has enough total value to enchant the item (per the magic item creation cost rules), it can add the magical properties of any weapon it has absorbed to the attached weapon. Once the crystal is attached the only way to unattach it is to destroy (ruin) the weapon it is currently affixed too.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wondrous Item, magic weapon; Cost 1,500 gp
